title: Novel insights into anti-inflammatory activity-related metabolic markers and biosynthetic regulatory mechanisms between principal and lateral roots of Aconitum carmichaelii Debx. via integrated metabolomics and transcriptomics.
authors: Pei, Wenhan; He, Fan; Xie, Ying; Wang, Zhengtao; Li, Linnan; Yang, Li; Zhou, Hua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过代谢组学和转录组学分析乌头主根与侧根的抗炎活性差异及生物合成调控机制，仅涉及分子对接验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The principal roots (CHW) and lateral roots (FZ) of Aconitum carmichaelii Debx. are widely used medicinal herbs in Asia. Although the two roots are derived from the same plant, they exhibit differences in anti-inflammatory activity (AIA). In the market, small FZ is frequently passed off as CHW. Therefore, revealing AIA-related markers and biosynthetic regulatory mechanisms between CHW and FZ are critical for the quality control of these medicinal materials. OBJECTIVE: To identify AIA-related markers and reveal the biosynthetic regulatory mechanisms of these markers. METHODS: A "metabolite-gene-efficacy" correlation strategy was adopted. Firstly, verified the AIA difference between CHW and FZ via RAW264.7 cell model and Cyclooxygenase-2 inhibition assay, then integrated metabolomics and transcriptomics to screen AIA-related markers and regulatory genes, finally validated the results via qRT-PCR, AIA assay and molecular docking. RESULTS: 12 AIA-related diterpenoid alkaloid (DA) markers were identified, with 3 components as specific discriminative markers for CHW and FZ. A novel "modular regulatory" mechanism of DA markers biosynthesis was revealed: 8 DA markers in FZ were regulated by highly expressed 3‑hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase in the mevalonate pathway, while 4 high-accumulation DA markers in CHW were positively driven by 1-deoxy-d-xylulose-5-phosphate reductoisomerase, 1-deoxy-d-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase, ent‑kaurene oxidase, ent‑kaurene synthase and BAHD-type acyltransferase in the methylerythritol phosphate and DA skeleton biosynthesis pathways, and 5 transcription factor families regulated the expression of the above-mentioned synthases. CONCLUSION: This study establishes a "gene regulation --> metabolite accumulation --> efficacy formation" framework to explain the AIA difference between CHW and FZ, provides specific markers for their quality control, and offers novel insights for DA biosynthetic engineering.
abstract_zh: 背景：乌头（Aconitum carmichaelii Debx.）的主根（CHW）和侧根（FZ）是亚洲广泛使用的药用植物。尽管这两种根源自同一植物，但它们在抗炎活性（AIA）方面表现出差异。市场上，小规格的FZ常被冒充为CHW。因此，揭示CHW和FZ之间与AIA相关的标记物及其生物合成调控机制，对于这些药材的质量控制至关重要。目的：识别与AIA相关的标记物，并揭示这些标记物的生物合成调控机制。方法：采用“代谢物-基因-功效”关联策略。首先，通过RAW264.7细胞模型和环氧化酶-2抑制实验验证CHW和FZ之间的AIA差异，然后整合代谢组学和转录组学筛选与AIA相关的标记物和调控基因，最后通过qRT-PCR、AIA实验和分子对接验证结果。结果：鉴定出12个与AIA相关的二萜生物碱（DA）标记物，其中3个成分作为CHW和FZ的特异性区分标记物。揭示了DA标记物生物合成的一种新型“模块化调控”机制：FZ中的8个DA标记物由甲羟戊酸途径中高表达的3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶调控，而CHW中4个高积累的DA标记物由甲基赤藓醇磷酸和DA骨架生物合成途径中的1-脱氧-d-木酮糖-5-磷酸还原异构酶、1-脱氧-d-木酮糖-5-磷酸合酶、内-贝壳杉烯氧化酶、内-贝壳杉烯合酶和BAHD型酰基转移酶正向驱动，且5个转录因子家族调控上述合酶的表达。结论：本研究建立了“基因调控→代谢物积累→功效形成”的框架，以解释CHW和FZ之间的AIA差异，为其质量控制提供了特异性标记物，并为DA生物合成工程提供了新见解。
